data.narrative:
Valthos is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company that has raised $30M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 10 comparable companies—two public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and eight private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic. The five most directly comparable private peers span from $125M to $4.0B in valuation across Seed and Series A stages.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using $30M total raised as a proxy for current value and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, implies a valuation of $75M. Peer-median analysis across five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (UFORCE at $1.0B, Stark Defence at $4.0B, Castelion at $1.0B, Singularity at $400M, and NODA AI at $125M) yields a median of $1.0B. The wide peer range ($125M–$4.0B) reflects heterogeneity in Defense & Security valuations across funding stages and capability sets.

The triangulated range is $64M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $538M. The substantial gap between stage-progression and peer-median methods reflects tension between Valthos's early-stage capital deployment and the valuations commanded by comparable-stage defense-tech peers. Key uncertainties include the company's specific technical differentiation, customer traction relative to the peer set, and capital efficiency relative to prior Seed-stage exits in the sector.
